description: This Dart source file defines the AppRouter class for managing navigation routes in a Flutter application. It specifies route names, handles route generation with fade transition animations, and maps route names to corresponding screens.

classes.name: AppRouter
classes.description: A class providing centralized route management including route name constants and a method for generating routes with fade transition animations.

methods.name: onGenerateRoute
methods.description: Generates a route with a fade transition based on the given RouteSettings; maps route names to corresponding screens.
